tb21_profile.skill: Design DNA oligos that satisfy a conjunction of hard numeric/biochemical constraints (Type-IIS BsaI site + spacer + 4nt fusion overhangs, 15-45nt anneal region, 58-72C Tm from an external oracle tool, pair dTm<=5, minimal number of pairs) and emit them in an exact FASTA format.
tb21_profile.domain: Molecular / synthetic biology: Golden Gate cloning, restriction enzymes, plasmids, PCR primers, reverse complement, primer3 oligotm.
tb21_profile.task_form: Implement-from-spec / constrained design search, verified against an external CLI oracle, with a strict output-file contract.

verifier_notes: scientific-computing_20260513_204536_003 is graded `weak` in the packet (`ok` in work/verifier_strength.json) but I read the instruction: 11 tests over 6 explicit numeric constraints (8bp length, Hamming>=3 vs 20 barcodes, exactly 4 GC, no 3-mer homopolymer, positional balance, FASTA header format). The heuristic undercounts because most assertions are computed over the candidate output rather than compared to a literal; in practice it is nearly ungameable and I treated it as ok/strong. task_003951_424ee2df (TMax, primer GC/Tm/homopolymer feature table) is graded FREE with 1 test - excluded everywhere despite a good surface match. tw_346139 (GFF3 validation), tw_338534 and tw_1025 (BLAST db builds) and scientific-computing_20260414_080620_004 (plasmid digest) are FREE and excluded from final_top10.

notes: CalibForge and TMax dominate; the honest top 10 is 5 CalibForge + 5 TMax and no other corpus earns a slot. Terminal-Lego-15k is effectively empty for this task - a whole-corpus grep found only two instructions mentioning DNA at all (task_08980, task_09030), so ranks 3-10 there are constraint-search / exact-output analogues with overall<=2 and should not be trusted as transfer. Recursive-Task-Synthesis has four genuine bioinformatics entries (two of them near-duplicate wgsim tasks) and nothing that designs a sequence; all are `absent`-graded. TerminalWorld's best bio tasks (BLAST db builds tw_338534, tw_1025; GFF3 validation tw_346139; GDB/GenomeTools tw_14129) are graded FREE, so I dropped them and its list bottoms out on unrelated constrained-enumeration tasks. SWE-Smith contributes only sequence-alignment algorithm repairs (string2string, textdistance); SWE-Rebench's only real biology is the three cogent3 issues. Merge step: the two new corpora clearly beat the old ones here - CalibForge supplies the single best candidate and half the final list.
